title: feat(coach): setup wizard with Stripe Express onboarding, first package, invite + QR, Home checklist (S-COACH, T4)
body:
## Tier header

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | **T4** (C-329-5: promoted with the #641/#332 money set; the wizard creates and publishes priced packages and gates on Stripe charges/payouts state) |
| **Why** | Coach setup wizard drives Stripe Connect Express onboarding (opens the hosted page, reads and refreshes Connect state) and creates and publishes the coach's first priced package. Wrong state copy would tell a coach they can take payments or receive payouts when Stripe says otherwise; a duplicated create would put two priced packages in front of clients. No money moves in this PR. |
| **T4 trigger scan** | Payment-adjacent writes: YES (priced package create + publish, now idempotent end to end with backend #641). Connect charges/payouts truth: YES. No auth/session change, no fee math, no tenancy change (only the coach's own `/coach/*` and `/v1/coach/*` routes), no migration, no new env, no package.json change. |
| **T3 trigger scan** | Connect onboarding state: YES (`/coach/connect/onboarding-link`, `/coach/connect/status[/refresh]`). Navigation shell: YES (`SettingsStack.CoachSetup`, Home checklist on Command Center Overview). |
| **Bounded T1** | NO. |
| **Builder-owner** | Lane S-COACH (agent 111); fix round 2 S-COACH-MOB-2 (agent 112); fix round 3 S-COACH-3 (agent 113, Claude Opus 5.5); fix round 4 S-COACH-MOB-4 (agent 114, Claude Opus 5.5). |
| **Acceptance evidence** | `src/components/coach/setup/__tests__/coachSetup.test.tsx` (17 tests): Connect state normalisation for new and older backend payloads; refresh falls back to GET status on 404; wizard walks the 6 backend steps strictly one at a time and sends step data once; starts the wizard when the server has no row; error copy for CONNECT_NOT_CONFIGURED / configuration_missing / CONNECT_ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE / 429 / 401 / offline / #629 package codes, unknown errors show request reference + support address and go to Sentry, no "something went wrong", no exclamation marks; Stripe requirement keys in plain words with deadline; $19.99 floor or free; free package created one-time at $0, published, bound to the invite link; QR encoding; Get paid flow re-mints an expired Stripe link once (refresh URL), closes on return, shows the refreshed state; specific copy when payouts are not configured; checklist order and done flags; resume step. Existing `commandCenterScreens`, `commandCenterNavigation`, `pushTapRouter` suites pass. `tsc --noEmit` clean. |
| **Promotion triggers** | Already T4. Any change to package pricing rules, publish semantics or the Idempotency-Key contract needs both lenses again. |

## What a coach can do now

1. **Practice basics** — name and focus (saved to onboarding step 1 with the device time zone; prefill the first package name and description).
2. **Get paid** — "Continue with Stripe" opens Stripe-hosted Express onboarding in an in-app browser sheet (`WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync`, URL checked with `assertStripeUrl`). Stripe collects bank account and ID. The sheet closes when Stripe returns to `tgp://connect/onboarding/return` (via backend PR #641's HTTPS landing); if Stripe sends the refresh URL (link expired) the app mints a new link and reopens once. The app then calls `POST /coach/connect/status/refresh` and shows the truthful state: not started, details needed, Stripe checking, Stripe needs more (each requirement in plain words plus deadline), ready, or disconnected. "Check status again" while Stripe reviews. If payouts are not configured on the server (503) the coach is told plainly and can continue; free packages still work.
3. **First package** — prefilled `<Practice> coaching`, $49.00 a month, switchable to one-time or Free. Client check mirrors #629 (paid $19.99 and up, free is one-time). Creates with an idempotency key, publishes, and for a free package binds it to the coach's permanent invite link (`grant_mode: free`) so a client who joins gets it. Skipped if the coach already has a package.
4. **Invite first client** — permanent link from `GET /coaches/me/invite-link`, Share sheet, Copy, and a QR code (vendored MIT `toqr` encoder drawn with `react-native-svg`, no network).
5. **Ready** — checklist summary, then completes onboarding (walks to backend step 6, `POST /coach/onboarding/complete`).

Every step can be skipped and stays reachable: the **Home checklist** on Command Center Overview (Get paid, first package, invite first client, first client payment) opens `CoachSetup` (Get paid / Invite) or Packages. The last item ticks from `GET /v1/coach/money/charges?status=paid&limit=1` (backend #641; falls back to the first-payment gate on an older backend); the moment itself is celebrated by the existing `FirstPaymentWowHost` behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_ROMAN_FIRST_PAYMENT_WOW`. The card hides once all four are done. The wizard resumes on the step the server has.

## Depends on
- Backend #641 for `state`/`requirements` fields, `/coach/connect/status/refresh`, the HTTPS return landing and `/v1/coach/money/charges`. Every call is feature-detected: on an older backend the state is derived from the booleans, refresh falls back to GET status, and the payment tick falls back to the gate.
- Operator: set `STRIPE_CONNECT_RETURN_URL` / `STRIPE_CONNECT_REFRESH_URL` to the #641 landings (see #641).

## Notes
- Support address: `COACH_SUPPORT_EMAIL` is now an alias of the repo-wide `SUPPORT_EMAIL` (`src/constants/support.ts`, #324 guard passes).
- Stacked follow-up: TGP Money (Home Money card + Money page, redirects old Earnings/Business metrics) builds on this branch.

## Fix round
Round 2 at `83ee0e4` (merge of main `2c17c241` at `c57e380`, fixes at `7ec0b2c` and `83ee0e4`). Closes AUD-OPUS-4 (comment 5960028238) and AUD-SOL-5 (comment 5960771086) in one round.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before) |
|---|---|---|---|
| A-329-1 | Home checklist no longer opens the retired Earnings screen: "First client payment" opens Invite before the first payment and Packages after it. The Money page itself ships in stacked PR #332 (base: this branch), which redirects the old Earnings and Business metrics routes to Money and deletes the client for the six routes that never shipped. | `7ec0b2c` (+ #332) | `coachSetupRound2.test.tsx` "A-329-1 checklist never opens the retired Earnings screen"; #332 `money.test.tsx`, `paymentsConnectPackages.test.ts` "no source file calls the six routes" |
| B-329-1 | First package retry never duplicates: created and published packages are remembered across retries; a timed-out create is looked up on the server before resending; the idempotency key rotates only on a definitive 4xx (not 408/409/429); changed inputs update the existing draft. | `7ec0b2c` | "B-329-1 first package retry never duplicates" (4 tests) |
| B-329-2 | CONNECT_NOT_CONFIGURED: "Payouts are not switched on for your account yet", finish setup and connect Stripe later from the Home checklist, support address and reference. | `7ec0b2c` | "B-329-2 payouts not configured" |
| B-329-3 | Step saves send the flat per-step blob the backend stores verbatim (`step_data[step] = body`); resume reads it through `stepBlob`, which also unwraps the `{data: ...}` blob earlier builds saved. | `83ee0e4` | "B-329-3 ..." round trip against a backend-faithful mock, legacy resume, flat resume; `coachSetup.test.tsx` advanceWizardTo assertions corrected to the flat body |
| B-329-4 | An active account with currently-due or past-due requirements keeps "Clients can pay you now", lists what is due with the deadline, and offers "Update details with Stripe" (same onboarding-link flow). | `83ee0e4` | "B-329-4 active account with Stripe requirements due" (currently due, past due, nothing due) |
| C-329-1 | Only live (published, not archived) packages count; a draft shows "Make X live". | `7ec0b2c` | "C-329-1 live packages only" |
| C-329-2 | Invite tick from the server (`/coach/clients?status=all&take=1`); a shared link is only a hint. | `7ec0b2c` | "C-329-2 / C-329-4 checklist from server data" |
| C-329-3 | Wizard step 5 loads Connect status, live package and client count on mount. | `7ec0b2c` | "C-329-3 wizard resumes on the last step with server truth" |
| C-329-4 | Checklist read failures show specific copy, reference and a retry; unknown items say "This could not be checked just now." (round 3: no first person) | `7ec0b2c` | "a failed read shows specific copy with a retry that reloads" |

Failing-before: the round-2 tests run against `4071d0ce` code fail 9 of 10 (`7ec0b2c` set; the definitive-400 key rotation test is a regression guard) and 6 of 8 for `83ee0e4` (2 corrected `coachSetup.test.tsx` assertions plus round trip, legacy resume, currently due, past due; flat resume and nothing-due are guards).

Commands (via `/home/user/workspace/ops/heavy.sh`): `npx jest --runInBand src/components/coach/setup/__tests__` = 2 suites, 33 tests passed. eslint on changed files: 0 errors.



## Fix round 3 (S-COACH-3, agent 113)
Head `e8ea080` (merges main `aae30ac` at `e8ea080` and `f34b5b9` at `fb265c8`). Closes the open items from AUD-SOL (5960983148) and AUD-OPUS (5961048256) at `83ee0e4`, plus operator ruling OR-112-16 (package create idempotent end to end) together with backend #641 (B-641-5).

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before, passing after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-329-1 (Sol) / C-329-6 (Opus) / OR-112-16 | One create attempt = one Idempotency-Key and one body, written to device storage BEFORE the request (`src/lib/coachSetup/packageCreateIntent.ts`, `coachSetup.packageCreate.v1:<coachId>`, 24 h). Every retry, including after the app is killed, re-sends exactly that pair; no list lookup. 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` adopts the `package_id` the key made and saves the new details onto it; 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` and 410 have their own copy; a definitive 4xx drops the intent. "Setup picked up where you left off" note on resume. In-flight double-tap guard. | `63d4550`, `25a9855` | `packageCreateIdempotency.test.tsx` (5: stored before send, kill-and-reopen re-sends same key+body once, publish-failed reopen never re-creates, definitive refusal rotates, TTL); `coachSetupRound2.test.tsx` B-329-1 block (rewritten, incl. double tap while in flight) |
| OR-112-16 (Opus follow-up, `CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx:189`) | Package editor create sends a stable key per attempt (was a fresh key per tap), adopts on 422 reuse, rotates on success or definitive 4xx; generic "Could not save / Please check your inputs" replaced by `describeError` copy. | `25a9855` | `src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen.idempotency.test.tsx` (5) |
| Connect truth (lane brief) | `connectCopy` splits pending_verification / restricted by `chargesEnabled` vs `payoutsEnabled`: it never says payouts work when Stripe has them off, and names exactly which half is on. | `a2961cc` | `connectCopyStates.test.ts` |
| Owner copy rule | No first person in client-facing errors ("TGP had a problem on its side", "TGP could not ..."); one support address from `src/constants/support.ts`. | `63d4550` | `coachSetup.test.tsx` copy assertions; `supportEmail.guard.test.ts` |
| C-329-5 | Tier header updated to T4 (title already T4). | PR body | n/a |
| C-329-7 | Paid tick relies on #641's paid filter; B-641-2 (lost chargeback never `paid`) closed at #641 `bb17e19a`, confirmed by Sol AUD-SOL-10. No mobile change needed. | n/a | #641 `coach-money-production-writes.spec.ts` B-641-2 |
| A-329-1 | Money page ships in stacked #332 (dual-approval pending); closes when the operator merges #332 into this branch. | #332 | #332 `money.test.tsx` |

Commands (via `/home/user/workspace/ops/heavy.sh`, at `e8ea080`): `npx jest --runInBand --forceExit src/components/coach/setup/__tests__ src/constants/__tests__/supportEmail.guard.test.ts src/__tests__/paymentsConnectPackages.test.ts src/__tests__/coachSaasBlockers.test.ts src/__tests__/CoachPackageEditScreen` = 9 suites, 134 tests passed. eslint on changed files: 0 errors (1 pre-existing unused-var warning in `CoachPackageEditScreen.tsx`). prettier applied.
